sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 463 x 396 x 55 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Telos Alliance Axia Pulsar specification sheet (Broadcasters General Store copy), opened 2026-11-12: main unit 463 x 396 x 55 mm (W x D x H), 8 motorised 100 mm faders, expandable by an 8-fader unit; the surface has an RJ45 LAN (AoIP and PoE+ power, no mains inlet), a locking USB-C expansion port (proprietary), HDMI and USB-A for a touchscreen; the audio I/O is on the separate StudioCore engine or on an OPTIONAL surface I/O board (2 mic inputs, a stereo line input, a stereo line output on RJ45 with the StudioHub pinout, a stereo headphone output on 1/4 in TRS). The sheet gives no panel per connector and the unit is pre-release (availability Q4 2026), so the connector set is not documented: beta-modelled with the LAN port and the optional-board ports as a stand-in. The side profile is an estimate (the sheet gives one height). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, faders, knobs and screens drawn without lettering, no photo, no logo. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess) and the side profile is an estimate drawn from the three outer sizes (no drawing opened). Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
